title: Preservation of work-tape head positions
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Gamma$ and $Q$ be types, let $e$ be an embedding of the Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$, and let $x$ be a finite word over $\Gamma$. For every configuration $D$ of a $k$-tape Turing machine with input $x$, decoding its symbols leaves the work-tape head positions unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $e$ is an embedding of the Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$
$D$ is a configuration of a $k$-tape Turing machine with input $x$
